summary: 47-year-old woman snowshoeing the Jenny Creek Trail from Eldora Nordic Center reported overdue Feb 22; ground + air search found her alive ~200 ft off the trail after ~8 hours; she spent the night out with serious injuries, evacuated by snowmobile and airlifted to hospital, expected to survive (case 21-908)
location: Jenny Creek Trail, Eldora Nordic Center
notes: INSERT run974: BCSO news release Feb-22-2021, case 21-908. Agencies: BCSO, RMRG, Front Range Rescue Dogs, Boulder Emergency Squad, Eldora Ski Patrol, USAF Rescue Coordination Center, NFPD, Flight for Life, Alpine Rescue Team.
